title: Quick-Hot-Gram-Cromotropo QHGC Lugol Solution
author: Javier Antonio Benavides
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bf8fjrtn
materials: Let to dry at room temperature
Permanent fixation use xylene for 1 min

steps.title: Homogenize Sample
steps.instruction: Homogenize the sample well using a wooden toothpick within its container.

steps.title: Prepare Smear
steps.instruction: Create a grade spread of approximately 2 cm long by 2 cm wide on a degreased, dry, or clean and scratch-free slide.

substeps.instruction: Slide the stick impregnated with fecal matter onto the slide.

steps.title: Thin the Spread
steps.instruction: Remove excess stool using a clean, chopped wooden toothpick to make the spread as thin as possible with minimal lumps.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the removal process with another clean chopped toothpick if necessary.

steps.title: Fix the Plate
steps.instruction: Fix the plate in absolute methanol for 5 min.

steps.title: Dry the Slide
steps.instruction: Allow the slide to dry at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Proceed immediately to staining or store the slide in a box wrapped in absorbent paper.

steps.title: Stain with Crystal Violet
steps.instruction: Cover the spread with Crystal violet for 1 min.

steps.title: Wash Slide
steps.instruction: Wash the slide under running water to remove excess dye.

steps.title: Decolorize
steps.instruction: Cover the slide with an acid alcohol solution for 3 min until discolored.

steps.title: Microscopic Visualization
steps.instruction: Visualize the sample under a microscope using immersion oil at 100X magnification.

steps.title: Mount the Slide
steps.instruction: Allow the slide to dry and cover it with a cover slide and Entellan®.
